metrics.description: Evaluates the ability of tests to fail when the underlying code logic is altered, measuring whether tests are sensitive enough to catch subtle mistakes that structural coverage might miss.
metrics.derivation:
Logic Error Sensitivity =
(total jobs - surviving mutants) / total jobs
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Sensitivity Score = (Survived Mutants caught by assertion-only tests / Total Survived Mutants) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 70% of survived mutants caught by targeted assertion tests

metrics.description: Serves as a meta-metric that validates the quality of your existing coverage. While statement coverage tells you if a line was executed, this measures how well that line was actually tested.
metrics.derivation:
Test Rigor =
(total jobs - surviving mutants) / total jobs
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Rigor Score = (Killed Mutants / Total Mutants Generated) × 100

metrics.description: Pinpoints exactly which surviving mutants were not caught, identifying specific areas where test cases need to be added or strengthened to write more meaningful assertions.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Weak Spot Count = Count(Modules where Mutation Kill Rate < 50%)
metrics.expected_threshold: 0 modules with mutation kill rate below 50%

metrics.description: Measures the test suite ability to catch errors at boundaries by specifically mutating operators, identifying if tests are robust enough to handle the precise limits of the code logic.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Boundary Kill Rate % = (Boundary Operator Mutants Killed / Total Boundary Mutants) × 100

metrics.description: Ensures the test suite is powerful enough to protect the code against future accidental regressions, measuring the stability of the safety net provided by the tests during updates.
metrics.derivation:
Regression Strength =
K (in changed modules) / M (in changed modules)
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Resilience Score = (Post-Change Mutation Kill Rate / Pre-Change Mutation Kill Rate) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: Resilience Score >= 95% (< 5% kill rate degradation after change)

metrics.description: Confirms that the tests are actually verifying the intended behavior (semantics) rather than just executing the code, measuring alignment between the code logic and the expectations in test assertions.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Semantic Pass Rate % = (Mutants testing semantic behavior killed / Total Semantic Mutants) × 100

metrics.description: % of artificially introduced code mutations (mutants) killed by the test suite — measures test quality not just coverage
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Mutation Kill Rate % = (Killed Mutants / Total Non-Equivalent Mutants) × 100
